description:
AMAZING Snickers Ice Cream Recipe 🍦🥜🍫 | Just Like the Candy Bar!

If you love Snickers, you’re going to be obsessed with this ice cream. It’s rich, creamy, peanutty, chocolatey, and perfectly swirled with peanut caramel – it tastes just like the iconic candy bar. This isn’t just a Snickers-inspired dessert… it’s Pure bliss even if I say so myself!

Made from scratch with real roasted peanuts, gooey caramel that doesn't feeeze solid, and the flavor of nougat imbedded in the ice cream, this recipe is a must-try for ice cream lovers and candy fanatics alike.

🕒 Timestamps:
0:00 – Intro: Snickers Ice Cream? YES PLEASE
1:08 – Ingredients
2:40 – Making the Ice Cream Base
5:05 – Peanut Caramel
8:22 – Churn and load
8:56 – Scoopy scoppy
10:36 – Eating said ice cream
9:55 – Outro

⸻
Ingredients:

Nougat base:
550g Milk (2cups + 3tbsp)
550g Cream (2cups + 3tbsp)
66g SMP (1/4cup)
110g Snickers Nougat (8 x 52g snickers worth)
220g Sugar (1cup)
OPTIONAL 1.2g Stabilizer (1/4tsp)

Stracciatella milk chocolate:
100g Milk Chocolate (1/2cup)
7g Refined Coconut Oil (1.5tsp)

Peanut caramel swirl:
150g Salted Peanuts (blended small) (3/4cup)
200g Caramel:
      250 sugar (1cup + 3tbsp)
      100 water (1/4cup +3tbsp)
      25 butter (1tbsp + 3tsp)
      250 cream (1cup)
      50 glucose or corn syrup (3tbsp)

⸻

🧊 Keywords & Tags:
Snickers ice cream, homemade Snickers dessert, candy bar ice cream, caramel swirl ice cream, nougat ice cream, peanut caramel chocolate ice cream, frozen treats, gourmet ice cream recipe, no churn Snickers ice cream, candy bar copycat recipes, best homemade ice cream, Snickers flavor ice cream, how to make ice cream at home

⸻

Why this recipe rocks:
✔ Tastes exactly like a Snickers bar
✔ Easy to follow, step-by-step
✔ No difficult to get ingredients
✔ Creamy, crunchy, sweet, and salty in every bite

⸻

💬 Have a favorite candy you want turned into ice cream? Drop it in the comments!
👍 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and share with your fellow sweet tooth friends.

comments.text:
Maker: Lello Musso

It's because of Nick that I ventured into this world of Ice Cream, which includes making homemade Caramel that is incorporated in many flavours. However, let me say this; Peanut caramel is out of this world! My wife was scooping direct from the jar while cooling, which needed to be addressed!
Adding the nougat to the base gives the base an amazing, nutty, sweet and thick feel that I loved. I will definitely be using that idea in the future. I think a Hazelnut nougat (or nougit:)) made with nougat and hazelnut caramel swirl would taste amazing. 
The only thing is, when I made this, I feel that I put too much of the Stracciatella into the base. This was my second recipe ever made, so I was heavy handed on my add ins. I have since realised that nick makes enough add in to be stored for future use. 

Overall, He says it's a difficult make, and it is, but well worth it!
